en: The front side of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an old church interior, highlighting a stone baptismal font, crucifix, and religious statues, with the text beneath the image reading 'Interiör af Alnö gamla kyrka.' The reverse has handwritten text in Swedish, address fields, and a red stamp marked 'Sundsvall', dated 8.6.01, along with more handwriting.
